name: Knee Push Up
body: holds a push-up from her knees with both hands planted under her shoulders, body in one straight line from head to knees, lower legs lifted off the floor with ankles crossed behind her. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Knee Up
body: marches on the spot driving one knee up to hip height with the foot lifted, standing tall on the other leg with arms bent at her sides. Hip flexors softly washed in sage green.

name: Kneeling Kickback
body: kneels on all fours with one knee bent at ninety degrees and driven up and back behind her until the sole of her foot faces the ceiling, back flat and hips level, hands under her shoulders. Glutes softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Lateral Hop over Bench
body: is caught in mid-air hopping sideways over a low padded bench, both feet together and knees softly bent, arms tucked in front of her chest, body facing forward. Glutes and calves softly washed in terracotta.

name: Lateral Hop over Line
body: is caught in mid-air hopping sideways with both feet together over a line on the floor, knees softly bent and arms tucked in front of her chest, body facing forward. Calves and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Lateral Lunge
body: steps wide to one side and sinks into that hip with the knee bent and the other leg straight and long, foot flat with toes forward, torso hinged slightly forward with hands together at her chest. Adductors and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Leg Lift to Hip Lift
body: lies on her back with both legs lifted straight up toward the ceiling, then pressing through her heels to peel her hips off the floor so her legs and hips rise as one. Abdominals and glutes softly washed in sage green.

name: Leg Lower
body: lies on her back with both legs straight and lifted toward the ceiling, lowering them together in a slow arc toward the floor with her lower back pressed down and arms long at her sides. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Leg Throw Down
body: lies on her back with both legs raised over her hips and her arms reaching up to meet them, hands near her ankles as she lowers her legs, head and shoulders lifted off the floor. Abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Lunge Jump Switch Hop
body: is airborne mid-switch of a jump lunge, knees bent and legs scissored with one forward and one behind, arms driving in opposition, torso upright. Quadriceps and glutes softly washed in terracotta.

name: Lunge Jump to Knee Drive
body: lands from a jump lunge onto one leg and drives the opposite knee up high in front of her, standing tall on a softly bent support leg with arms driving. Quadriceps and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Lying Leg Raise
body: lies flat on her back with both legs straight and together, lifting them toward the ceiling in one slow piece with her lower back held to the floor and arms pressed at her sides. Abdominals softly washed in sage green.

name: Marching in Place
body: marches on the spot lifting one knee to hip height with the foot flexed, standing tall on the other leg with arms swinging naturally in opposition. Hip flexors softly washed in sage green.

name: Med Ball Slam
body: stands with feet hip-width apart swinging a medicine ball down toward the floor between her feet, hinging forward with soft knees and straight arms, ball just above the ground. Abdominals and shoulders softly washed in terracotta.

name: Med Ball Slam to Squat Jump
body: is in a low squat holding a medicine ball at her chest, hips back and knees deeply bent, about to drive up and slam the ball down. Quadriceps and abdominals softly washed in terracotta.

name: Medicine Ball Burpee
body: is in a push-up position with both hands resting on top of a medicine ball on the floor, body in one straight line from head to heels. Chest and abdominals softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
body: stands facing forward holding a medicine ball at her chest with both hands, elbows tucked and weight shifted onto her front foot, pushing the ball straight out and away. Chest and shoulders softly washed in terracotta.

name: Mermaid Side Bend
body: sits with her legs folded to one side and one hand planted on the floor beside her, sweeping the other arm up and over her head in a long side bend so her ribs lengthen away from her hips. Obliques softly washed in sage green.

name: Mountain Climber Burpee
body: is in a low plank with both hands on the floor under her shoulders and one knee drawn forward under her chest, the other leg extended long behind, hips level. Abdominals and hip flexors softly washed in terracotta.

name: Mountain Climber Cross
body: holds a high plank on both hands with one knee drawn across her body toward the opposite elbow, the other leg long behind, hips level and back flat. Obliques softly washed in sage green.

name: Plyo Push Up
body: is at the top of an explosive push-up with her body in one straight line and both hands leaving the floor, palms just above the ground, legs extended behind her. Chest and triceps softly washed in dusty rose.

name: Prone Leg Lift
body: lies face down with her forehead resting on her hands, lifting both legs straight off the floor together with her hips staying pressed down and toes pointed. Glutes and lower back softly washed in sage green.

name: Reformer Elephant
body: stands on the wooden reformer in a long inverted V with both feet flat on the carriage and both hands pressing on the footbar, hips lifted high and spine long and straight, head between her arms.

name: Reformer Feet in Straps Leg Press Down
body: lies on the reformer carriage with both feet looped into the overhead straps and her legs pressing down and away in long parallel lines, arms resting at her sides, head supported.

name: Reformer Hundred
body: lies on the reformer carriage with her head and shoulders curled up off the pad, arms long and straight by her sides pumping a small range, both legs lifted and held straight out at a low angle.

name: Reformer Knee Stretch
body: kneels on the reformer carriage on all fours with her hands on the footbar and her back rounded up toward the ceiling, hips drawn over her knees, carriage pressed back.

name: Reformer Kneeling Lat Pull Down
body: kneels upright on the reformer carriage facing the straps, gripping both handles above her head with elbows bent and pulling them down toward her shoulders, ribcage lifted.

name: Reformer Long Box Pull
body: lies on her stomach along a long padded box on the reformer, gripping the straps overhead with both hands and pulling them back past her shoulders, chest lifted and legs long behind her.

name: Reformer Standing Lunge
body: stands in a split stance on the reformer carriage with one foot forward and one behind, back heel lifted and knee lowered, torso upright with hands on her hips, carriage sliding under her.
